instruction: Use BRL-CAD to read the STEP input file(s) from the Desktop path(s): /home/user/Desktop/part_ref.step. Read /home/user/Desktop/part_ref.step. Generate an inspection fixture block from the reference part: first create an envelope block that adds 4 mm total clearance in X, Y, and Z around the reference bounding box; subtract the reference body from the envelope while adding an additional 2 mm clamping clearance; finally cut one guide hole of diameter 8 mm on each side, with hole axes along Y, hole centers on the fixture height midplane and 15 mm from the two end faces. Export exactly one STL mesh named /home/user/Desktop/out.stl to the output folder.
